answer.origin: The Diplomat (media, published 2026-07-02) relaying Singapore Police Force statements and investigator allegations; original speaker Singapore authorities; no statement date given in the record.
answer.note: Excluded from research evidence per the research-scope exclusion for the Singapore server-transshipment case overview. The article reports that Singapore police charged four people and issued a prohibition of disposal order on a property, in an investigation into servers that may have contained advanced Nvidia AI chips shipped from Singapore to Malaysia, with final destination unclear and some media reports suggesting China. Because the case overview is excluded, this record does not support any conclusion about NVDA's business, customers, supply, or competition, and no interpretation is drawn from it.
limitations: The record is excluded from research evidence by the research-scope exclusion, so no conclusion about NVDA is drawn from it.
The source states the servers 'may have contained' Nvidia chips and that the ultimate destination is unclear, so no Nvidia chip shipment is established even apart from the exclusion.
Named server suppliers (Dell, Super Micro, Asus) and the Aperia and Luxuriate entities are not shown to have a direct commercial relationship with NVDA.
